title: Lockstep
pitch: Your jump is the only thing that arms your blade — and a kill is the only thing that re-winds your jump.
howto: Jump to arm the pendulum blade, strike to snap-lunge into clockwork prey. Every kill re-winds your boots mid-air, so chain jump-kill-jump without landing. Bank long chains for cogs and buy workshop upgrades.
controls: Walk with the arrow buttons, BOOT button jumps, BLADE button strikes (it snaps to nearby prey). Keyboard: A/D + Space + J (K dash). Xbox pad supported.
